exact_statement: On the uniform five-bit cube, E*(5)=max_{f nonconstant} min_{i:Inf_i(f)>0} H(S_i|S_-i)/Inf_i(f) equals K5=16/3-(3/8)log2(3)-(169/24)log2(13)+(89/24)log2(89). Equality holds exactly for the 640 truth tables whose minority class is {t,t xor e_i,t xor e_j}, with t in F2^5 and distinct coordinates i,j, allowing output complement. The associated spectral law is P(S)=fhat(S)^2 and entropy is in bits.
